title: Maximum wind power expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly derive and state the final expression P_m = (1/2)πρr²v³.

title: Power proportionality reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly apply the cubic relationship P ∝ v³ to find the output power at the lower wind speed.

title: Annual energy calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the final numerical answer for minimum annual generation as 8 × 10⁵ kW·h.

title: Mass flow rate derivation
description: Important Criteria: The response should show the reasoning for the mass flow rate (ρ * v * area) as part of finding the kinetic energy flux.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The response may demonstrate that the units in the final energy calculation (kW * hours = kWh) are consistent.

title: Incorrect exponent for speed
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses a linear or square relationship (P ∝ v or P ∝ v²) instead of the correct cubic one.

title: Area misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect area (e.g., 2πr or πr) instead of the swept area πr².
